title: Choose Prava UI's visual world
question: The roll assigned Cobalt Porcelain. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Cobalt Porcelain
options.thesis: Every control feels like fired glaze: cool white, deep cobalt, light catching the rim.
options.viewport: A SaaS settings screen: neutral side rail, glazed-white work area, cobalt reserved for the primary action and selection.
options.risk: The glaze rim reads dated and skeuomorphic if pushed past one hairline highlight.

raised.raise: One stroke weight shared by focus ring, checkbox, progress and spinner.
Every dimension snaps to a 4px grid; control heights step in 8s.
State layers (hover, selected, focus) overlay and never shift geometry.
Every component carries the same slot anatomy and state attributes.
A handful of root variables recolor the whole system coherently.

options.label: Identity Manual
options.thesis: Every component specified like a page in a corporate standards manual: grid, rule, one signal blue.
options.viewport: The same settings screen on a strict column grid, hairline rules for structure, flat signal blue for action.
options.risk: Also the direction most libraries in this category land on; familiar, less ownable.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and boarding passes
options.thesis: State changes move and stay lit until noticed: neutral panels, one change colour.
options.viewport: Settings as segmented panels with tabular figures; a changed field holds its highlight until acknowledged.
options.case: Strong audience fit for operational SaaS; loses on clarity as a general-purpose library default.
options.risk: Reads like an ops console when used for calm consumer-facing forms.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Lines bend only at disciplined angles; the network is the composition.
options.viewport: Steppers and tabs drawn as route lines.
options.case: Four line colours break the restrained, not-colourful brief.
options.risk: Becomes a costume outside navigation components.
options.kept: One disciplined stroke weight across all indicators.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The construction grid is visible and everything snaps to its cells.
options.viewport: Components on a visible cell grid.
options.case: Needs display letterforms; Prava must inherit the consumer's font.
options.risk: Ornamental grid lines on working screens.
options.kept: Every dimension snaps to one base grid.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: Terrain is fixed; the purple course layer rides above and never edits it.
options.viewport: State drawn as an overprint layer.
options.case: Multi-ink palette and terrain texture don't fit SaaS defaults.
options.risk: Texture where surfaces should be quiet.
options.kept: State overlays never change component geometry.

options.label: Character Catalog
options.thesis: A finite roster where every member has the same fixed furniture.
options.case: Wrong audience: pastel and bounce don't serve business users.

options.label: Variable Specimen
options.thesis: One slider drives the whole page through a custom property.
options.viewport: A giant glyph morphing under a slider.
options.case: Depends on shipping a font, which Prava never does.
options.kept: A few root variables drive the whole system.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Neutral gray surfaces, one blue accent, flat cards: what component libraries ship, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The settings screen every SaaS template shows, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
